segment_performance.highlight: Core digital banking migrations and Topaz AI adoption across European banking clients.
Demand for automated warehouse management and personalized shopping AI models.
5G network slicing optimization and customer support automation.
Smart metering analytics and carbon transition compliance software.

simple_pointers: **Positive Top-Line Momentum:** Consolidated revenue grew **+2.94% QoQ** to **₹40,120 Cr** in Q1 FY27, backed by broad-based volume growth across manufacturing and financial services.
**Operating Margin Maintained within Target Band:** Operating margin stood at **21.1%** (Operating EBIT: **₹8,465 Cr**), benefiting from Project Maximus cost-optimization programs.
**Solid Yearly Profit Expansion:** Net Profit (PAT) increased **+9.48% YoY** to **₹6,580 Cr** despite quarterly seasonality and wage cycle timing.
**Robust Large Deal Pipeline:** Secured **$4.1 Billion** in large deal TCV, with net new deals contributing over 52% of total contract value.
**Upgraded Full-Year Guidance:** FY27 constant-currency revenue growth guidance raised to **4.0% – 5.0%**, reflecting growing confidence in AI transformation spend.

strengths: Proprietary Infosys Topaz GenAI suite embedded in 350+ active client engagements.
Consistently strong free cash flow conversion at 105% of net profit, supporting capital return.
Diversified client portfolio with revenue from Top-10 clients at healthy 19.2% concentration.
weaknesses: Telecom segment growth remains subdued due to selective client capex rationalization.
Quarterly sequential PAT contracted (-4.21% QoQ) due to seasonal tax adjustments and utilization changes.
opportunities: Enterprise scaling of AI agent automation and cloud FinOps optimization programs.
Rising demand for ESG compliance and green infrastructure software solutions in the EU.
threats: Pricing pressure in commoditized legacy application maintenance renewals.
Stricter work visa rules in target export jurisdictions impacting mobility costs.
